ActsOn.description: The joint a brake-type instance holds (DES-043); a brake on a transmission-driven joint sits on its shaft.
ActsOn.title: ActsOn

Calibration.description:
The known deflection under `load` and first natural frequency the lumped member is calibrated to (DES-034).

`load` is a point load at the free end (clamped-free) or at midspan (any other support pair); `deflection` is
the deflection at the load point.
Calibration.title: Calibration

Contact.description: The neutral model's contacts element field for field (DES-042, ADR 0003), plus the floor plane.
Contact.title: Contact

ContactParameters.description: Soft contact (ADR 0002): normal stiffness and damping, Coulomb friction coefficient.
ContactParameters.title: ContactParameters

EventCode.description:
A named event-log code and how its argument reads (DES-045, round 4 ruling 28): `axis` the instance of the
pulse_output binding of that channel, `fault` or `state` the design's code name (a state argument may pack a
from-to pair as (from << 8) | to, read `from>to`), `number` verbatim, `none` no detail.
EventCode.title: EventCode

Firmware.description:
`state_codes` and `fault_codes` name the firmware's reported `state_code` and `fault_code` values (DES-045);
the application target is `mechsim_fw_<design name>` in the firmware tree (DES-040).

event_codes.description: event_log code (0..255) to the event's name and its argument kind (axis, fault, state, number, none)
event_codes.title: Event Codes

Firmware.title: Firmware

FlexibleMember.description:
A flexible member (DES-033). `section` may be omitted when the body's catalog part carries one (LIB-030);
`calibration` may be omitted, and the member then uses its section and material as is (BLD-019).

carries.description: joints the member carries (DES-033, ENG-052, ruling 63): each joint's parent is this body, the lumped chain's parent; its in-plane load reaches the body through the chain
carries.title: Carries

damping_ratio.description: modal damping ratio of the first bending mode, dimensionless in [0, 1) (DES-047, ruling 78); absent: undamped, the member's ringing set by the integration scheme
damping_ratio.title: Damping Ratio

FlexibleMember.title: FlexibleMember

Floor.description: The floor plane on the world: points x with normal . x = offset; contact acts on the side the normal faces.
Floor.title: Floor

InertiaTensor.description: About the center of mass, in the body frame.
InertiaTensor.title: InertiaTensor

MaterialPair.description: Contact parameters overriding the default for one unordered pair of materials.
MaterialPair.title: MaterialPair

MaterialsConfig.description: `overrides`: path, relative to the design file, of a materials override file (brief M3-M).
MaterialsConfig.title: MaterialsConfig

MechanicalBinding.description: A mount of the instance's type bound to a body (housing, face) or a joint (shaft).
MechanicalBinding.title: MechanicalBinding

default.description: Value used when neither the case nor --set gives one (DES-044): a quantity string of the parameter's dimension, or a choice value
default.title: Default

dimension.description: pint dimensionality string, or "choice" for a non-quantity
dimension.title: Dimension

Placement.description: The joint frame in the parent body's frame.
Placement.title: Placement

RectangleShape.description: Solid rectangle: `height` along the bending direction (member y), `width` across it.
RectangleShape.title: RectangleShape

RectangularTubeShape.description: Hollow rectangle of uniform `wall`; `height` along the bending direction.
RectangularTubeShape.title: RectangularTubeShape

Rope.description: A rope from a catalog part of a rope type (LIB-020), emitted as a lumped chain (BLD-032, ADR 0016).
Rope.title: Rope

RopeEnd.description:
One end of a rope: a point in a design body's frame, or the case payload named here (attached at run time,
so that end is not emitted by the builder until the case places the payload).
RopeEnd.title: RopeEnd

Section.description:
Cross-section and span (DES-033, ruling 25): a `shape` with its dimensions; or `area` with `second_moment` (the
symmetric shorthand: both axes equal, optional `fibre_y` and `fibre_z` together, else evaluated single-axis); or
`area` with both axes explicit, `second_moment_y`, `second_moment_z`, `fibre_y`, `fibre_z` (member frame: z the
axis of bending along y, so `second_moment_z` is the neutral member's `second_moment_of_area`). E and rho come from
the body's material.
Section.title: Section

Senses.description:
What a sensor instance reads (DES-043): the joint coordinate, and per type the switch position along the joint
and its actuation side (limit_switch) or the count direction (incremental_encoder); a load cell may read the case
payload by name instead of a joint, or the reaction of a joint (`joint_reaction`: a design joint, or a case payload
by name, read at its fixed joint to the carrier; ruling 24), an IMU reads a body. Exactly one of joint, payload,
joint_reaction and body.
Senses.title: Senses

StepGeometry.description: A STEP file, resolved relative to the design file; the body's declared mass properties are checked against it.
StepGeometry.title: StepGeometry

Wire.description:
A connection from one instance port to another (DES-041); ports are the pins of each type's electrical facet.

Wires carry connectivity only in v1: no resistance, inductance, length or failure. Physical wire properties are a
later component type (a seam).
Wire.title: Wire
